## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `./scripts/check.sh`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I tested the relevant CLI command with `--dry-run` before a model run.
- [ ] I did not add generated media, model weights, third-party source trees, logs, or credentials.
- [ ] I reviewed new dependencies, downloads, model licenses, and output-rights implications.
- [ ] Documentation is updated in English and Russian when user-facing behavior changed.

## Risk and rollback

State what could break, what was not tested, and how to revert the change.
